source_revision: Shopify GraphQL Admin API 2026-10 (latest stable per shopify.dev/docs/api/usage/versioning on 2026-11-01; 2025-10 is listed unsupported)
identity_rule: Account scope = Shop.id. Record identity = "allocation:<FulfillmentOrder gid>"; provider_event_id = "<shop>|fo:<numeric id>|<updatedAt>".
coverage_rule: Fulfillment orders with updated_at in the plan window / since the incremental floor; the assignment is planned work, never a reservation (is_stock_reservation = false on every record).

retention.basis: Shopify API License and Terms of Use, merchant-owned data, read-only custom app; the merchant owns its order/payout data and installs the app on its own store. Raw provider payloads are stored as sanitized evidence (no customer names/emails/addresses) under the workspace retention policy.

allocation_id.normalization: FulfillmentOrder gid (record) with per-line FulfillmentOrderLineItem gids.

quantity.normalization: remainingQuantity (outstanding work) as decimal string; total_quantity carried separately.

unit.normalization: Constant unit "piece": Shopify line quantities are integer counts without a unit field.
unit.rule: connectors.normalize.shopify.v1: unit = "piece" for all Shopify quantities.

status.normalization: completed when remainingQuantity = 0, otherwise the lowercased FulfillmentOrder status (open, in_progress, on_hold, scheduled, cancelled...).

policy_version.normalization: Constant "shopify-fulfillment-order-assignment.v1": declares that the allocation is the provider assignment, not a workspace allocation policy.

evidence_id.normalization: journal_evidence id of the raw FulfillmentOrder payload stored with the source entry.
evidence_id.rule: connectors.ingest.v1: evidence_refs[0] of the source entry

event_rules.unsupported_reason: Shopify exposes no reservation evidence; a fulfillment-order location assignment is not a stock reservation (CONNECTOR-CAPABILITIES finding 1). Reservations must come from a generic producer.
No reservation is recorded from Shopify, so no release is recorded either.

event_rules.rule: One fact per observed FulfillmentOrder updatedAt with remaining quantities per line; no reservation track is derived.

synchronization.initial_import: BlackboxFulfillmentOrders (first=20, lineItems first=25) with updated_at:>=requested_from; Relay pagination; no provider count.
synchronization.cursor: Incremental updated_at:>=floor with 900 s overlap; Relay endCursor within a run.
synchronization.reconciliation: Daily (bounded after sleep/wake) re-read of updated_at within the window.
synchronization.deduplication: provider_event_id includes updatedAt; identical content duplicates, differing content conflicts.
synchronization.freshness: Poll every 900 s (300 s-6 h, jitter 60 s).

local_standalone.history_limit: Fulfillment orders as exposed by the API; closed fulfillment orders older than the window are not re-read.
local_standalone.authentication: Admin API access token for a merchant-installed custom app (X-Shopify-Access-Token), or the Dev Dashboard client-credentials grant (POST /admin/oauth/access_token, 24h token, refreshed one minute before expiry, no redirect URL). The token is stored encrypted on the connection (AES-256-GCM, key outside the database) and never logged.
local_standalone.recovery: Provider cursor and phase are persisted per page in import_runs.checkpoint / capability_health.*_cursor after COMMIT; a failed page never advances the checkpoint. Expired cursors restart the current phase from its floor (idempotent through the deliveries dedupe boundary). 401/403 stop polling with status reauthorization_required/degraded; 429 waits for Retry-After (fallback 1 s); 5xx retry with exponential backoff (max 5 attempts) then the run is re-queued with backoff; non-retryable failures become visible dead letters. After sleep/wake one coalesced poll per poll group plus one bounded overlap reconciliation (gap + overlap, capped at the reconcile window) is scheduled; no burst replay.
local_standalone.limitations: Planned work only; no reservation semantics; line pages beyond 25 are flagged.
local_standalone.reason: Polling works for planned fulfillment work; reservation evidence is missing, so the capability is partial.

local_gateway.limitations: No gateway runtime exists in the pilot; declared and refused by the connector (LOCAL-07).
local_gateway.reason: local_gateway is deferred scope for the local pilot (delivery-profile.json); no gateway is provisioned and the capability declaration lists no methods for it.

public_server.limitations: No public callback is registered; localhost cannot receive Shopify webhooks.
public_server.reason: public_server is deferred scope for the local pilot; direct webhooks would require a public HTTPS endpoint that the pilot does not provide.

import_readiness.time_selection: FulfillmentOrder.updatedAt selects both the import window and incremental reads (no created_at filter is used).
import_readiness.historical_availability: Current assignments only; earlier assignment changes are not reconstructed.
import_readiness.open_and_related_records: Open fulfillment orders of older orders are included through the updated_at window only; related orders are read by shopify.orders.
import_readiness.opening_state: Not applicable: an assignment is not an opening reservation balance.
import_readiness.progress_accounting: loaded = fulfillment orders fetched; committed = distinct fulfillment orders with a new fact; totals unknown.
import_readiness.readiness_rules: Allocation questions that need reservations are blocked/partial for Shopify-only workspaces (explicit missing fields); questions about outstanding fulfillment work are ready after a complete poll.
import_readiness.health_rules: healthy after a complete poll within interval + jitter; degraded on missing fulfillment-order scopes.
import_readiness.history_expansion: Re-reading a wider updated_at window; no older reservations appear.
